Make a Difference

Support Our Mission

Prep Up is sustained by community-led generosity. Whether you’re a private donor, a local business, or a grantmaking foundation, your support fuels equitable college access for Southcoast students.

Ways to Give

Three Ways to Support Prep Up

Every form of support — financial, institutional, or in-kind — goes directly toward expanding access for Southcoast students.

Private Donors

Fueling initial access through community-led philanthropy. Individual contributions of any size help us expand our cohort capacity and deepen our support for each student.

Corporate Partners

Investing in the local talent they will hire one day. Southcoast businesses that partner with Prep Up are building a more educated, more competitive regional workforce.

Grant Funding

Integrating with local education initiatives. Prep Up is positioned to partner with foundations and grant-makers committed to closing equity gaps in higher education access across Massachusetts.

Why the Southcoast?

New Bedford and the surrounding Southcoast communities are home to thousands of talented high school students who never receive the college guidance they need and deserve. Most independent school students benefit from a dedicated college counselor managing a caseload of 10–15 students. In public schools, that ratio can exceed 400:1.

Prep Up closes that gap — at no cost to students and families.

Get in touch to learn more about supporting Prep Up.

All funding inquiries and partnership conversations start with a simple email. We’d love to hear from you.
